name: AMR Splatting with FFT
aliases: Data projection on a Cartesian grid
definition: A volume rendering technique for AMR data where cells are converted into points with size information, projected to 2D, and convolved with a Gaussian kernel using FFT to produce a summation plot.
summary: AMR Splatting with FFT is a volume rendering technique that projects AMR data onto a Cartesian grid and uses FFT-based Gaussian convolution to efficiently produce MIP-like images for large datasets.
